title: Owner Rewards Rate on Kessler Care Retail Plan Purchases
content:
# Owner Rewards Rate

A replacement purchase of a Kessler Care Prepaid Maintenance Plans retail plan takes an Owner Rewards rate according to the tier of the customer's service account in the Service Accounts and Repair Orders records. The rate is a fraction of the plan's retail basis price.

| Service account tier | Owner Rewards rate |
|---|---|
| Kessler Owner Rewards Platinum | 0.06 (6 percent) |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Gold | 0.04 (4 percent) |
| Kessler Owner Rewards Silver | 0.02 (2 percent) |
| Any other account (Service Guest Account, Commercial Fleet Account - Net 15 or Net 30) | No Owner Rewards rate |

Hypothetical illustration: on a hypothetical basis price of 350.00, a Gold account's rate of 0.04 takes 14.00 off, leaving 336.00.
